capabilities: Preview notes in WeChat Official Account layout
Apply per-note styles, 42 themes and generated title covers
Copy or export formatted HTML and long PNG
Send and update WeChat drafts through an AppID connection
Hand drafts to X, Zhihu and Xiaohongshu via Qiaomu Clipper
disambiguation: Not a website or Obsidian Publish tool; it formats notes for WeChat Official Account and hands drafts to other social platforms.
extras: Plugin UI is currently Chinese. Draft creation and updating were tested against a controlled local service, not a live WeChat account; iOS and Android are untested. Audio, video and embedded web pages must be inserted manually in WeChat. Credentials are stored in Obsidian SecretStorage.
motivation: The author's premise is that a note should not need formatting twice: write in Obsidian, then preview and send the same content.
problem: Notes written in Obsidian have to be reformatted and re-pasted by hand before they can go out as WeChat Official Account articles, and repeated edits leave duplicate drafts.

relations.evidence: The desktop publishing window also hands drafts to Qiaomu Clipper 1.18.7+ in Chrome.
Choose the Qiaomu fixed-IP relay, direct API access from your device, or an existing self-hosted qmblog Bridge.
First-run migration reads the older Qiaomu Agent publishing settings in the same vault
You need a WeChat Official Account AppID, AppSecret, the relevant API permissions and IP allowlisting.

requires.name: WeChat Official Account with AppID, AppSecret and API permissions

summary: Formats notes into WeChat Official Account article style with live preview, themes and covers, then copies the HTML or sends drafts.
